title: A configuration object that can't drift
prompt: Arrange the lines into `ForecastConfig`, an immutable configuration with a 24-hour horizon, lags (1, 2, 24) and a feature list, where each instance gets its own list. One block would crash when the class is created.
hints: The decorator goes directly above the class. `frozen=True` makes assigning to a field raise an error, so a config can't be changed halfway through a run.
A dataclass refuses a plain list as a default for exactly the reason a function's mutable default is a bug: it would be shared. `field(default_factory=...)` builds a fresh one per instance.
import, decorator, class line, then the three fields (the feature list uses default_factory).
